title: Herbal Slovakian Saskatoon Berries Soup
description: A fragrant, plantbased soup that marries juicy saskatoon berries with soothing herbs and a splash of coconut milk, perfect for a monsoonswayed Slovakian-inspired dessert.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the vegetable broth, bay leaf, ground ginger, basil, parsley, and dill; bring to a gentle simmer and infuse for 5 minutes.
In a separate small saucepan, combine 1 cup of the vegetable broth with the lemon zest and gently poach the saskatoon berries for 3–4 minutes until softened.
Remove the berries and set aside; discard the lemon zest and bay leaf.
Return the infused broth to the pot and stir in the coconut milk; bring to a low simmer.
Add the maple syrup, fresh lemon juice, and the poached berries; stir to combine.
Simmer the soup gently for an additional 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Taste and season with salt and freshly ground pepper as desired.
Serve the soup hot, optionally garnishing with a few fresh herbs or a swirl of coconut milk.
Enjoy this fragrant, herbal dessert soup inspired by Slovakian traditions.
